description: Check a Merkle proof against a root, the way OpenZeppelin's MerkleProof.verify does on chain (sorted-pair keccak256): give the leaf hash, or the entry's values and their Solidity types (double-keccak OpenZeppelin leaf). Returns valid true or false and the root the proof leads to. Use before submitting an airdrop claim or to debug an allowlist mint. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

leaf.description: The leaf hash, or the entry's fields (comma-separated or a JSON array) to hash with types

proof.description: The proof: JSON array or comma-separated 32-byte hashes

types.description: Solidity types of value's fields (default address,uint256)

value.description: The entry's fields, instead of leaf (comma-separated or a JSON array)

name: merkle_verify
title: Merkle proof verify
